Description: Annie Beaumont has brief contact with Tony Dauer in the Attic. During this, an item is mistakenly operated and nearly hits someone downstairs. Tony Dauer then leaves and locks the door from the outside.
Location: Attic（Attic）
Key Information:
  - Tony Dauer knocks and enters the Attic to meet Annie Beaumont, confirming her identity as Annie Beaumont (Annie Beaumont).
  - Annie Beaumont clearly states that she has not returned here for many years and is temporarily staying in the Attic to visit her sister.
  - It can be inferred that Person No. 7, Victoria Maseko, has a younger sister, and since this is the only sister relationship in the scene, Person No. 7 can be identified as Person No. 2's sister.
  - Tony Dauer touches and pulls an unknown device in the Attic without permission, causing an item to fall and nearly hit someone downstairs.
  - Annie Beaumont clearly points out that there is someone downstairs during the falling incident, confirming a direct vertical connection between the Attic and the lower level.
  - Tony Dauer mentions rumors about a girl who once lived in that Attic room for a long time and had mental abnormalities.
  - Annie Beaumont clearly states she does not want to go to the Living room and chooses to stay alone in the Attic.
  - After leaving the Attic, Tony Dauer closes the door and locks it.
Characters:
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2, a visitor temporarily staying in the Attic.
    · Confirms she has not returned here for many years and is here to visit her sister.
    · Clearly indicates she is aware of the danger of the devices in the Attic.
    · Refuses to go to the Living room and chooses solitude.
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, Eve Dauer's younger brother.
    · Enters the Attic to meet Annie Beaumont and identifies her true identity.
    · Operates an Attic device without permission, causing a falling-object incident.
    · Locks the Attic door from the outside when leaving.
